resources.string: WristPrompt
Continue with ChatGPT
Continue with ChatGPT using your paired phone.
Looking for phone…
Waiting for phone… Open WristPrompt on your phone and tap Continue with ChatGPT.
Companion unavailable. Connect your phone and install WristPrompt there.
Could not confirm receipt. Check both devices and try again. Your phone may have received the request.
More than one companion is available. Connect only the intended phone and try again.
wristprompt_wear
Authorizing… Finish in your phone’s browser.
Identity connected. ChatGPT plan usage disabled.
Protected credentials unavailable. Requests are blocked. Secrets cannot be recovered here; reauthorization or API-key reconfiguration is required once protected storage is available.
Chat could not be saved. Previous saved messages are unchanged. Check available storage and try again. Your sign-in details have not been reset.
Authorization failed on phone. Open WristPrompt there for details, then retry from watch.
Authorization expired. Try Continue with ChatGPT again.
ChatGPT plan usage is enabled. When ChatGPT plan is selected, eligible AI requests use your plan. OpenAI API mode uses separate API billing. Manage ChatGPT usage in ChatGPT settings.
Got it
On your phone, open WristPrompt and tap Manage ChatGPT usage, or open ChatGPT → Settings → Usage. Review your plan or WristPrompt’s limit.
response.completed received, but the streamed test output did not match exactly.
Stopped. Partial output is not a completed proof.
Authorization must be renewed. Use Continue with ChatGPT for this saved account.
ChatGPT plan usage is limited. Pause testing and review Manage usage.
ChatGPT plan usage could not be checked. Keep this account and retry later.
ChatGPT plan usage is unavailable for this account, workspace, or policy.
OpenAI did not accept this account’s permission or policy. Check the account and plan grant.
OpenAI is temporarily unavailable. Credentials are preserved. Wait before retrying.
OpenAI client, route or session configuration requires attention. Credentials are preserved; repeated sign-in is not an automatic fix.
ChatGPT session cannot refresh yet. Wait and reload models. Credentials are preserved.
ChatGPT session renewed on this watch.
OpenAI rejected the request or selected model. Reload the catalog and choose a supported model.
Could not reach OpenAI. Check the watch’s internet connection and retry explicitly.
No displayable model is available. Reload the account catalog; select a model again if it changed.
Stream interrupted before response.completed. Partial text is not success.
OpenAI returned response.incomplete. Partial text is not success.
WristPrompt could not process the response. No successful proof was recorded.
Account changed during the request. Reload models for the selected account.
Signed out locally. Remote renewable-session revocation confirmed.
Signed out locally. REMOTE REVOCATION NOT CONFIRMED. Disconnect WristPrompt in your ChatGPT account settings if needed.
API key not configured. Enter it on the paired phone; no ChatGPT fallback.
OpenAI rejected API authentication (401). Check the key and API account access. ChatGPT was not used.
OpenAI API rate, credit or quota limit. Review your API billing account; ChatGPT was not used.
Listed model IDs do not guarantee Responses text support. Choose a compatible model.
Thinking level is no longer supported. Choose Default or a supported value in Models.
Image capability unavailable for this model and billing route.
A selected or saved photo is missing or damaged.
Photo count or storage limit reached.
Add text to ask about the selected photos.
Image generation requires a reviewed model and OpenAI API billing. No request sent.
Enter text up to 8192 characters and remove input photos before generating.
Generated image invalid, missing or too large. No completed image saved.
